reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Coding Edits Policy (Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid)

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy does not specifically address this DRG pattern, but it governs observation stays in contracted acute care hospitals. Observation is excluded when the admission requires intensive critical care services such as mechanical ventilation, and otherwise observation services may be bundled into inpatient or DRG compensation.

utilization_limits: hours of observation on same claim line

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: For facility claims, routine room/board items, supplies, nursing services, and certain equipment are bundled into the room and board, facility, or ancillary charge and are not separately reimbursable. The policy also limits facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management to one unit per day.

utilization_limits: 1 unit per day ventilator or CPAP management

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Deny observation billing for G0378, G0379, 99221-99223, and 99231-99235 unless billed by the attending physician on the same claim and same date of service, within three days of admission, with hours of observation on same claim line, capped at max 48 hours of observation, and tied to revenue codes 0762 or 0769 across Commercial Products, Public Plans, Senior Products, and Medicare Advantage products. Exempt: intubation and mechanical ventilation. Peer: Point32Health denies observation services using G0378/G0379 and 99221-99223/99231-99235 unless they are on the same claim and same date of service, within three days of admission, capped at max 48 hours, and billed by the attending physician..

Recommendation 2: Bundle UB04 facility charges reported under revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270-279, 300-370, 391, 410, 412, 419, 460, and 510, and limit ventilator or CPAP management to 1 unit per day; exempt professional charges. Exempt: professional charges. Peer: United Health bundles these UB04 facility revenue codes and caps ventilator or CPAP management at 1 unit per day while exempting professional charges..
